title: Rooted Realm Modpack
description: This is the official modpack for the Rooted Realm server providing optimisations and QOL features that make it all the easier to enjoy playing on our server.
body:
# Rooted Realm Client

The **Rooted Realm Client** is the official client-side modpack for the **Rooted Realm Server**.  
It focuses on **performance, visual upgrades, and quality-of-life improvements** while keeping gameplay **fully vanilla-friendly**.

This pack enhances Minecraft with **modern shaders, smoother animations, better UI tools, and powerful building utilities** without changing the core mechanics of the game.

Whether you're exploring, building massive projects, or just hanging out on the server, this pack makes everything **look better, run smoother, and feel more polished.**

---

# ✨ Features

## 🚀 Performance Optimized
Built around **Sodium and FerriteCore** to dramatically improve FPS and memory usage while maintaining compatibility with visual enhancements.

Performance mods include:
- Sodium
- Sodium Extra
- FerriteCore
- Entity Culling
- Reese's Sodium Options

---

## 🌅 Beautiful Graphics & Shaders
Fully compatible with modern shaders using **Iris**, letting you choose from popular shader packs like:
- BSL
- Complementary
- Solas

Visual improvements include:
- Dynamic lights when holding torches
- Connected textures
- Custom entity models and textures
- Enhanced animations

Visual mods:
- Iris Shaders
- LambDynamicLights
- Fusion (Connected Textures)
- Entity Model Features (EMF)
- Entity Texture Features (ETF)

---

## 🎮 Gameplay Quality of Life
A variety of mods make everyday gameplay smoother and more convenient.

Quality-of-life improvements include:
- Inventory sorting
- Shulker box previews
- Ping display
- Smooth chat animations
- Free camera mode
- Zoom functionality

Mods included:
- Nemo's Inventory Sorting
- Shulker Box Tooltip
- Numeral Ping
- Smooth Chat
- Freecam
- Zoomify

---

## 🗺️ Navigation & Exploration
Never get lost again with powerful mapping tools.

- **Xaero's Minimap**
- **Xaero's World Map**

Perfect for exploring large builds or planning projects across the server.

---

## 🏗️ Building Tools
Builders get access to professional-grade schematic tools.

- **Litematica**
- **MaLiLib**

Plan, preview, and construct large builds with precision.

---

## 🎨 Interface Improvements
A cleaner and more modern interface with customization options.

- FancyMenu
- Chat Heads
- Chat Animation
- Mod Menu
- Moreoverlays
- Drippy Loading Screen

---

# 🎨 Included Shader Packs

This modpack includes several popular shader packs so you can easily choose the visual style and performance level that suits your system.

### High Quality Cinematic Shaders

BSL Shaders
Complementary Shaders Reimagined
Complementary Shaders Unbound
Solas Shader

### Performance Friendly Options

MakeUp Ultra Fast
Miniature Shader

These shaders work through **Iris Shaders**, allowing you to switch between them easily in game depending on your preferred visuals or performance.

You can change shaders in game from:

**Options → Video Settings → Shader Packs**

---

# 🖥️ Recommended Settings
For the best experience on Rooted Realm:

- Enable shaders through **Iris**
- Allocate **4–6GB RAM**
- Use **Sodium graphics settings** for performance tuning

---

# 🌳 Rooted Realm Server
This modpack is designed specifically for the **Rooted Realm Server** to provide:

- Smooth performance
- Beautiful visuals
- Helpful building tools
- Vanilla-compatible gameplay

Join the server and experience Minecraft with a polished client built for the community.

---

# ⚠️ Notes
- This is a **client-side modpack**.
- All mods are **server-compatible** and **do not change gameplay mechanics**.
